scope: Independent source and fixed-phase binding acceptance for the read-only history receipt collector. Actual phases, supervisor results and collection remain separate.
checks: The candidate adds only five declared substitutions: fixed retention/phase map, strict phase-plus-offset/hash argument selection, the two extra fixed retention ancestors, and phase/scope fields in the stable and outer records. Reversing them recovers all 5,474 baseline bytes at 1598cd0f; forwarding them recovers all 5,739 candidate bytes at f0c931cc.

Object.hasOwn validates membership in exactly the eight accepted phase names before selecting either path. No arbitrary path or output-name argument is accepted. The same phase selects exactly its driver result and assigned supervisor result, with eight complete fixed ancestor entries.

The final 1015 history source uses the fixed preservation root and the same eight phase names. The unchanged c0c289 supervisor accepts those phases, requires the coordination checkpoint-only-supervision- prefix and writes result.json. Backend independently confirmed all eight exact assigned suffixes; its future request-preparation packet must retain these same paths.

The raw file/parent/held-handle signature, final snapshot, missing-file representation, gzip, chunk identity and error handling blocks are byte-identical to the accepted collector. No receipt JSON is parsed or regenerated, so 64-bit ticks survive as original raw bytes.

A single BelowNormal Node process with 64 MiB heap, 1 GiB initial/live free memory, 128 MiB own RSS and 15-second internal/outer bounds remains unchanged. Sampling stays 100 ms; each file is capped at 2 MiB and aggregate raw bytes at 4 MiB.

The stable package contains only fixed scope, selected phase and ordered raw-file records. Timing/memory measurements remain outside it. Unchanged async level 1 gzip emits at most 37,500 compressed bytes per response with a 65,000-character whole-line ceiling.

The exact initial invocation decodes to the reviewed source and appends preserve, 0, dash. The longest accepted phase plus Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER decimal offset and 64-character digest is 7,862 characters, below 8,191. Only command, cwd, timeout_ms, expected_effects are supplied to the connector.

Every positive offset requires the exact package SHA256. Continuation retains the same phase and returned package identity; a different phase or changed receipt bytes changes the stable package digest and refuses the prior identity.

Read the full derivation, README and both clean author inspection records. The recorded cloud syntax-only check is retained as author evidence; this independent review performed byte comparisons and source inspection without executing the collector body.

acceptance_boundary.missing_or_failed_files: Keep their explicit raw observations and reconcile them; transport complete does not imply phase success.
acceptance_boundary.future_requests: Bind the actual phase supervisor_output to the fixed map; no collector path override or silent substitution is permitted.
acceptance_boundary.continuation: Use the same phase, exact returned next_offset_bytes and package_sha256, rehash each part and assembled gzip, then rehash every decoded raw file.
